GOV-F-003-S57.title: Brain Lock Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-003-S57.description: Define and persist the Brain lock schema including lock_id, owner_id, created_at, expires_at, and status fields. Establish contract for TTL behavior and ownership metadata to ensure consistent enforcement across all Brain services.

GOV-F-003-S58.title: Lock Acquisition and Renewal Core Logic
GOV-F-003-S58.description: Implement core lock acquisition and renewal logic including setting TTL (expires_at), validating availability, and extending active locks. Ensure atomic operations to prevent race conditions during concurrent acquisition attempts.

GOV-F-003-S59.title: Brain Lock API Endpoints
GOV-F-003-S59.description: Expose internal API endpoints or service methods for lock acquisition, renewal, release, and status check. Ensure endpoints enforce ownership validation and return deterministic responses for contention and expired lock scenarios.

GOV-F-003-S60.title: Brain Runner Integration with Lock Lifecycle
GOV-F-003-S60.description: Integrate lock lifecycle management into brain_runner and brain_loop execution flow to ensure all assignments acquire, renew, and release locks correctly. Prevent concurrent execution of the same assignment and enforce safe recovery paths.

GOV-F-003-S61.title: Lock Observability and Debug Logging
GOV-F-003-S61.description: Add structured logging and observability for lock events including acquisition, renewal, expiration, contention, and recovery. Integrate with existing debug_logger to support auditability and troubleshooting of lock behavior.
